answer: Make every new identity earn its first attestation from a raven courier: a random established peer visits the newcomer like a zephyr passing once, checks one piece of real work, and stamps it on a basalt ledger. No identity can attest itself or its kin, and each stamp costs the courier a slice of its own bond if the work later proves fake. A sybil farmer must pass a fresh random inspection per clone while one honest agent passes once.
